== Problem 7 ==


Circle <imath> X </imath> has a radius of <imath> \pi </imath>. Circle <imath> Y </imath> has a circumference of <imath> 8 \pi </imath>. Circle <imath> Z </imath> has an area of <imath> 9 \pi </imath>. List the circles in order from smallest to the largest radius. 

<imath> \textbf{(A)}\ X, Y, Z\qquad\textbf{(B)}\ Z, X, Y\qquad\textbf{(C)}\ Y, X, Z\qquad\textbf{(D)}\ Z, Y, X\qquad\textbf{(E)}\ X, Z, Y </imath>

== Solution ==

Not using the formulas of circles, <imath> C=2 \pi r </imath> and <imath> A= \pi r^2 </imath>, we find that circle <imath> Y </imath> has a radius of <imath> 4 </imath> and circle <imath> Z </imath> has a radius of <imath> 3 </imath>. Also, circle X has a radius of <imath> \pi </imath>. Thus, the order from smallest to largest radius is <imath> \boxed{\textbf{(B)}\ Z, X, Y} </imath>.
